name: Endomyocardial Fibrosis
aliases: Restrictive Cardiomyopathy due to Endocardial Fibrosis

criteria.description: Echocardiographic evidence of endocardial thickening and fibrosis predominantly affecting ventricular apices
Clinical and hemodynamic features consistent with restrictive cardiomyopathy
Exclusion of other causes of restrictive cardiomyopathy such as amyloidosis or sarcoidosis
Residence or origin from tropical endemic areas
Cardiac MRI showing late gadolinium enhancement consistent with endocardial fibrosis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of echocardiographic evidence of endocardial fibrosis and clinical features of restrictive cardiomyopathy with exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by imaging; biopsy is rarely performed.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Endocardial fibrosis localized to ventricular apices
pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic fibrotic thickening seen on imaging

common.notes: Due to impaired ventricular filling and heart failure

occasional.notes: Due to arrhythmias secondary to fibrosis
Non-specific symptom related to cardiac dysfunction
Occasional due to arrhythmias or low cardiac output

rare.notes: Secondary to atrial enlargement and stasis
Rare complication from pulmonary venous hypertension
Includes atrial fibrillation and ventricular arrhythmias

laboratory: Normal cardiac biomarkers unless heart failure present
imaging: Echocardiography showing apical endocardial thickening and restrictive filling pattern
Cardiac MRI demonstrating late gadolinium enhancement of endocardium
Chest X-ray showing cardiomegaly and pulmonary venous congestion
other: Endomyocardial biopsy showing dense fibrous tissue replacing endocardium

distinguishingFeatures: Positive Congo red staining on biopsy
Systemic symptoms including rash and neuropathy
Endocardial damage due to eosinophilic infiltration

redFlags: Rapid progression of heart failure symptoms
references: Mocumbi AO. Endomyocardial fibrosis: a form of restrictive cardiomyopathy. Heart Fail Rev. 2013;18(3):319-326.
Sliwa K, et al. Endomyocardial fibrosis: a neglected tropical disease. Lancet Glob Health. 2015;3(5):e260-e261.
Katz AM. Restrictive cardiomyopathy: endomyocardial fibrosis and other causes. Circulation. 1990;81(5):1101-1104.
